parsed.explanation: Documented tier-1/2 exposures: a trans woman convicted under s.153 in 2021 and imprisoned eight years in a men's prison; an international organization finding police arbitrarily arrest, detain and assault gender-nonconforming people; forced stripping, forced medical/HIV exams and photo distribution after arrests; medical staff denying treatment on gender-expression grounds; and a 2024 constitutional court upholding the provisions, leaving reform to a hostile legislature. Enforcement is arbitrary and violent, the state's own hand is implicated (official death-mongering, discontinued prosecution of a kill-the-gays statement, president's threats), and no remedy works—moratorium annulled, courts uphold. Hostile custody placement and criminalisation reach a visitor whose relationship reads as same-sex; no recognition exists. No documented border screening or execution record keeps it above the 0.15 tier, but severity plus absent recourse puts it at the severe boundary.
